explanation: OEIS A194806 (size of the smallest S ⊆ {1..n} with S·S ⊇ {1..n}), R. Israel: 'Is a(n)/A000720(n) bounded as n → infinity?' (since proved). The formal a takes the minimum cardinality over valid subsets (T itself is valid, so the minimum exists), and the statement asks for C with a(n)/π(n) ≤ C for n ≥ 2 (π(n) ≥ 1 there). This is boundedness. Faithful.
